scope: Narrow security-only changes: global Vercel response headers with CSP in Report-Only mode, loopback-only Vite dev/preview servers, Dependabot and scheduled dependency auditing, a Vite security-version guard, .gitignore update for local Supabase CLI metadata, and a read-only production database verification query. No Supabase migration, application business logic, data, UI, or refresh-session settings changed.
required_manual_dependency_update: The supplied lockfile pins Vite 6.4.3, affected by GHSA-p4f5-76q4-ffq7 when the dev server is network-exposed. Vite 6.4.6 is the first fixed 6.x release. The Vite registry could not be reached from this build environment, so package-lock.json was intentionally not hand-edited. Before committing/pushing, run: npm install --save-dev vite@^6.4.6. This updates package.json and package-lock.json with npm-generated integrity metadata. Then run npm run security:check.
database_sql: supabase/verify/Run114_Production_Security_Posture_READ_ONLY.sql is diagnostic only: BEGIN READ ONLY and ROLLBACK; it is not a migration and should not be run as a deployment migration.
manual_git_cleanup: supabase/.temp metadata is already tracked in the supplied repository. After applying the .gitignore update, run: git rm -r --cached --ignore-unmatch supabase/.temp. This removes it from the Git index but leaves the local folder on disk.
validation: 7/7 new targeted security tests pass; 19/19 targeted invite-security + new hardening tests pass; full test suite has 1200 pass and 18 failures, exactly matching the same 18 failures in the pristine uploaded ZIP; source stylesheet integrity check passes. Full Vite build and npm audit could not be executed in this sandbox.
